_file_purpose: Sample registry snapshot used by tests and detection rule validation.
_how_to_use: Use this file to validate parser behavior. Keep top-level keys stable: generated_at, host, registry_entries.

_field_guide.generated_at: ISO timestamp when snapshot was captured.
_field_guide.host: Machine name where registry data was collected.
_field_guide.registry_entries: List of installed software entries from uninstall registry paths.
_field_guide.registry_entries[].path: Registry path that contains uninstall metadata.
_field_guide.registry_entries[].display_name: Software name as shown in Add/Remove Programs.

notes: Reusable sample registry snapshot for parser and detection rule tests.
